project.description_en: At the end of the theme, the child acts a job (baker, tailor, nurse, mechanic…), names its tools, greets the customer politely in English and in French and counts money or goods up to 10.

activities.goal_en: Listen to a story about a job and say the steps in order.
activities.prompt_en: Listen to the story of Ewane the baker. What did he do first?
steps_en: Show a loaf of bread.
Tell the story with gestures: mix, knead, bake.
Ask: what did Ewane do first, then, at the end?
Act the baker’s work together.
observe_en: Says the steps in order with help.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 14 (Storytelling: Short stories), p. 39; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.story_en: Every night, while the town sleeps, Ewane the baker wakes up. He mixes flour, water and salt in a big bowl. He kneads the dough, push and fold, push and fold. He puts the bread in the hot oven. In the morning, the whole street smells good, and the children say: “Thank you, Ewane, for our bread!”

activities.goal_en: Imitate occupations with gestures and guess them.
activities.prompt_en: Look: I cut and sew. Who am I? Yes, a tailor!
steps_en: Mime a job without speaking (tailor, driver, farmer, hairdresser).
The child guesses.
The child mimes a job; you guess.
Name the tool used in each job.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 16 (Sign Language and Gestures: Mimes and mimics), p. 41; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Write the lowercase letters a and i correctly.
activities.prompt_en: The a is a round o with a little stick. The i is a stick with a dot on top.
steps_en: Trace a in the air: round, then down.
Trace i: down, then the dot.
Trace them in sand.
Write a row of a and a row of i.
observe_en: Forms a with a round part and a stick.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 18 (Writing: Letters and numbers), p. 43; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: « Bonjour, Madame ! Merci ! » at the shop
activities.goal_en: Greet the seller politely in French.
activities.prompt_en: At the shop we say: “Bonjour, Madame !” and after: “Merci, au revoir !”
steps_en: Set up a little shop.
Show how to greet: “Bonjour, Madame !”
Buy something and say “Merci !”
Leave saying “Au revoir !”
source_refs: Nursery One, table 19 (French: Salutations), p. 44; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: At the fruit seller: adding to 10
activities.goal_en: Add two groups up to 10 in a market game.
activities.prompt_en: You buy 4 oranges, then 3 more. How many oranges in your basket?
steps_en: Put 4 oranges (or stones) in a basket.
Add 3 more, counting on: five, six, seven.
Count all again to check.
Play seller and customer with other numbers.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 20 (Mathematics: Mathematical operations), p. 45; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

interactive.prompt_en: 4 oranges and 3 more oranges. How many in the basket?
interactive.explanation_en: Start at 4 and count on: five, six, seven. There are 7 oranges.

activities.goal_en: Build a miniature house with blocks or cartons.
activities.prompt_en: The builder makes houses. Let us build a little house with blocks.
steps_en: Show a picture of a builder at work.
Put blocks side by side for the walls.
Add a roof with a piece of carton.
Leave a door and talk about the materials of real houses.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 22 (Science and Technology: Construction), p. 47–48; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Detect appliances that use electricity and ask an adult to use them.
activities.prompt_en: The radio, the TV and the iron use electricity. Who can switch them on?
steps_en: Show pictures of appliances: radio, TV, iron, phone charger.
Find which ones use electricity.
Explain that only adults plug and unplug them.
With an adult, switch a radio or a light on and off.
observe_en: Says that an adult plugs them.
Switches a light on and off with an adult.
materials_en: a radio or a light switch
source_refs: Nursery One, table 22 (Science and Technology: Electrical appliances), p. 47–48; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: People who lead and help us
activities.goal_en: Identify some officials and leaders and respect them.
activities.prompt_en: At school, the head teacher leads. In the town, the mayor. In the village, the chief or the Fon.
steps_en: Show pictures: a head teacher, a mayor, a chief or Fon.
Say what each one does in one sentence.
Ask the child who the head teacher of the school is.
Practise greeting an important person politely.
observe_en: Says one leader of the town or village.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 24 (Citizenship: National emblems and officials), p. 50; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Stay away from sockets and wires and ask an adult for help.
activities.prompt_en: We never put fingers or objects in a socket and we never touch a broken wire.
steps_en: Show a socket and a wire (switched off).
Say the danger: it can burn and hurt.
Act: a child sees a broken wire and calls an adult.
Repeat the rule with a gesture: hands away!
observe_en: Calls an adult in the role play.
materials_en: a picture of a socket and a wire
source_refs: Nursery One, table 27 (Safety Education: Home safety), p. 53; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: At the nurse: telling where it hurts
activities.goal_en: Report symptoms of illness to an adult or a nurse.
activities.prompt_en: When we are sick, we tell an adult: “My head hurts”, “My tummy hurts”.
steps_en: Show a picture of a nurse.
Act a visit: the child says where it hurts.
The nurse uses a bandage on a doll.
Talk: medicine only from the nurse or parents.
observe_en: Plays the nurse or the patient.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 28 (Health Education and Nutrition: Treatment), p. 54; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Identify traditional and modern musical instruments.
activities.prompt_en: Listen: is it a drum or a guitar? Which one is traditional?
steps_en: Show pictures or real instruments: drum, xylophone, flute, guitar, piano.
Play or imitate each sound.
Sort: traditional (drum, xylophone) / modern (guitar, piano).
Play a rhythm on a drum or a bucket.
observe_en: Sorts traditional and modern with help.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 29 (Music and Dance: Musical instruments), p. 55; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Play tug-of-war as a team and accept the result.
activities.prompt_en: Hold the rope with your team. On “pull!”, pull together. Then shake hands.
steps_en: Make two equal teams.
Mark the middle of the rope.
Pull on the signal.
Shake hands after, whoever wins.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 32 (Physical Education and Sports: Team sports), p. 58; theme 7: Occupations (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

scale.description: Succeeds mostly with a model or help.
Sometimes succeeds alone, sometimes with a reminder.
Succeeds on their own in a familiar situation.

indicators: Names three jobs and one tool for each.
Builds a small house with blocks.
Says who can use electrical appliances.
Names the head teacher, the mayor or the chief.
Writes the letters a and i with help.

sources: Cameroon Nursery School Curriculum, English Subsystem, MINEDUB, 2018: table 13 (integrated learning themes), p. 37; Nursery One tables, cited and not reproduced.
